node.statement: The formerly missing amplified estimate is available in the current scope. If S_P is nonzero and e<=e_ca, validated node 1.1.5.1 applies lem-compcb-corner-algebra to make every E_n=M_n tensor S_P an alpha-C*-algebra with alpha=C_ca*e uniformly in n; validated node 1.1.5.2 then applies the product upper axiom and inherited involution isometry to obtain ||Z^dagger dot Z||<=(1+C_ca*e)||Z||^2. If S_P=0, then E_n=0 and the same inequality is trivial. Hence kappa=C_ca and e_sq=e_ca furnish the required estimate for all n.
